review_method.scope: Re-audit all 9 Career and all 35 Property temporal eligibility candidates against source scan spans and the current PL3-T compiler contract.
review_method.source_text_policy: The exact condition remains in the referenced canonical source row; source wording is not duplicated in this disposition artifact.

counts.note: Candidate dispositions are a partition; blocker-code counts are non-exclusive. Zero eligible means zero rows meet this compiler contract, not that the tradition contains no temporal rules.

reassessment_findings.summary: The current compiler requires an explicit source-reviewed natal antecedent, a positive temporal condition, one explicit rule.layer for every temporal atom, verified non-hypothetical normalization, and case_support_only=false. Eligibility ledgers are not runtime specifications.

The previous STAR_MUTAGEN_BINDING_GAP is superseded as a blanket implementation blocker: the current adapter emits star-bound TRANSFORMATION_PRESENT when the PL1 temporal star object itself carries mutagen. This does not make CA04-350 eligible.

CA04-350 remains blocked because its capital-shortage interpretation depends on the real-world commerce context in CA04-348, which the WP07A natal audit explicitly treats as a context-state gate, not a natal fact. CA04-349 is not a valid substitute antecedent. The source's major/annual scope must not be silently narrowed.
Annual Tanlang Hua Lu/Hua Ji temporal facts are representable, but the source does not supply an independent natal antecedent. A vacuous PALACE_PRESENT(P10) condition would invent semantics.

The source-supported natal context does not resolve the exact temporal star-bound fact shape: the adapter requires palace_name, but the source does not specify Tianji's temporal palace. Joining separate star-presence and scope-level mutagen facts is prohibited.

No source row satisfies all compiler gates in this bounded 44-candidate review. No temporal reaction spec is emitted; the Product production reaction registry remains unchanged and must stay empty pending a separate Product-owned validation/promotion unit.
